{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Attack_of_the_clones_3.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala having a picnic on a green meadow on Naboo.]]
{{Quote|What in blazes?''"<br />"''It's grass, sir.|Mosh Barris and Kavren discover a grass-filled flight suit|<ref name="Mist Encounter">{{JournalCite|7|Mist Encounter}}</ref>}}
'''Grass''' was the term used to denote a wide variety of [[Plant/Legends|plants]] of a certain type that were common on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The typical [[Species/Legends|species]] of grass grew as a single thin leaf from the ground; many single plants grew in close proximity to form literal carpets across the landscape. While most species flourished in broad plains, others thrived in the shady environs of forests.

The planet of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], before its destruction, was noted as being the home of over eight thousand species of grass;<ref name="FF18">{{FactFile|18|ALD 1-4|Alderaan}}</ref> it was also the home of [[grass painting]]s. [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] was also known for its [[Balmgrass/Legends|balmgrass]], a species that was soft to the touch.
